text:
- **chief complaint:** Routine follow-up for chronic conditions; patient concerns include fatigue, pursed-lip breathing, and a testicular nodule.
- **history of present illness:** Prior aortic valve replacement and ascending aortic aneurysm repair about eight years ago. Patient requests valve evaluation. Labs show elevated alkaline phosphatase (156), elevated total cholesterol (247) and LDL (166), normal TSH, and high-normal vitamin D (94).
- **physical examination:** Pursed-lip breathing, low exhalation phase, clear to oscillation, no wheezing. Right testicle has a 2–3 mm palpable nodule; left testicle normal; no hernia. Other systems normal.
- **symptoms experienced by the patient:** End-of-day fatigue, reduced cycling endurance (20–30 miles, previously 40), post-ride exhaustion, mild snoring, 6–7 hours of sleep per night, pursed-lip breathing without wheezing, right testicular nodule.
- **new medications prescribed or changed, including dosages:** N/A. Current regimen unchanged: vitamin D3 50,000 units on Sundays and 2,000 units on other days; clindamycin before dental procedures.
- **follow-up instructions:** Echocardiogram and stress test; cardiology follow-up (suggested physician); labs today with results via patient portal; pulmonary function tests; urology referral; MMR today; shingles vaccine next month; wellness visit in one year, sooner if needed.
